chapters.title: Synthetic carrier source R1
chapters.body: The courier capsule is ready only when its pressure is four bars and its valve cap is locked.

chapters.title: Synthetic carrier source R2
chapters.body: At 10:00 today the courier capsule pressure is four bars, but its cap remains loose and unlocked throughout that minute.

chapters.title: Synthetic carrier source R3
chapters.body: The 10:00 courier capsule inspection was performed at the north workbench.
